name: Swift and CocoaPods
description: Reads Swift Package Manager's Package.resolved (formats 1, 2 and 3, including Xcode projects and package registries) and CocoaPods' Podfile.lock: every pinned package with its exact version. Swift packages are checked against OSV's SwiftURL advisories. OSV publishes no CocoaPods advisories, so pods are inventoried but cannot be checked for vulnerabilities.
known_limitations: CocoaPods has no vulnerability source in OSV: pods are inventoried with their versions and shown as not checked
Swift packages pinned to a branch or a commit have no version and are not listed; the file's coverage counts them
Local packages (localSourceControl, CocoaPods :path:) are the project's own code and are not listed
OSV names Swift packages by repository URL; a package whose URL differs in letter case from the advisory's is not matched
